Sandbox_TrueSwimming_Enabled_tooltip: Disabled: water is impassable again, as in the base game.
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_KnowsSwimming: The survivor knows how to swim
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_KnowsSwimming_toolt: Disabled: swimming costs 2.5x more stamina (like a non-swimmer in Aquatsar).
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_StaminaMul_tooltip: Multiplies swimming fatigue. 1 = Aquatsar Yacht Club calibration, 2 = twice as hard, 0.5 = half.
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_Drowning_tooltip: What happens when stamina runs out while swimming.
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_ItemLoss_tooltip: Exhausted and overloaded, the swimmer drops the heaviest items (never what is worn).
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_ShowBar_tooltip: Shows a small stamina gauge above the swimmer.
Sandbox_TrueSwimming_Washing_tooltip: Three seconds after entering the water, blood and dirt are washed off your body and worn clothes, no soap needed.
Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_Swimming_toolti: XP multiplier of the Swimming skill (True Swimming), used when the global XP multiplier is disabled.
